description.purpose: Test checkout blocked by fines, requiring partial payment before checkout
description.relevant_policies: Fines exceeding $10.00 block all new checkouts until the balance is reduced to $10.00 or below through payment.
description.notes: Patron Margaret Chen has $12.50 in fines (above the $10 threshold). She wants to check out a book. The agent must handle partial payment to bring fines to $10 or below, then process the checkout.

instructions.task_instructions: Avid reader who is friendly but a bit impatient. Speaks casually and expects the agent to know the system well.
instructions.reason_for_call: You want to check out 'A Brief History of Time' at the Westside Branch. You know you have some overdue fines but you're not sure of the exact amount.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Margaret Chen. You want to check out 'A Brief History of Time' at the Westside Branch.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know your exact fine amount or that fines above $10 block checkout. When the agent tells you about the fines blocking checkout, agree to pay $3.00 toward fine_chen_gatsby using cash. Then ask the agent to proceed with the checkout.

ticket: Patron Margaret Chen wants to check out 'A Brief History of Time' at the Westside Branch. She has $12.50 in fines which blocks checkout. Agent must collect partial payment on fine_chen_gatsby to bring total to $10 or below, then complete the checkout.

actions.name: pay_fine

actions.name: checkout_book
